claim_ceiling: This benchmark proves only that REAL cached OpenCaseLaw rows carry the fields the query_result_bundle contract needs (decision_id, canonical_url on mcp.opencaselaw.ch, language, citation strings, statutes, a frozen-marker-rule text surface) and that the ACCEPTED harness rejects a regressed bundle. It does NOT prove that Product builds such a bundle, that the map is useful to a jurist, that counter labels are calibrated (counter_uncertainty is a fixed fixture constant), that the coordinates are a good layout (they are a deterministic fixture layout, not a geometry claim), or anything about the absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bars. Recall figures are measured, not thresholded.
evidence_summary: Run 39834312064: BENCHMARK_VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION (exit 0). 4 frozen questions, 24 cached OpenCaseLaw envelopes. All leg1 baseline checks PASS (bundle_nonempty, duplicate_free, source_urls_valid, answer_citations_constrained, counter_classifications_supported, geometry_preserved, progressive_phases, no_fixture_in_live_claim). Both falsification legs fire: blanked counter evidence -> counter_classifications_supported=False; broken source URL -> source_urls_valid=False. NEGATIVE RESULT honestly reported: counter-authority yield empty for 2/4 questions (corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule). Recall measured not thresholded (rent-default 3/9=0.333 counter reach; corporate-criminal-liability 4/6=0.667; business-judgment-rule 1/4=0.250; petty-theft-dismissal 6/9=0.667). 25/25 tests pass including test_counter_authority_is_empty_for_two_of_four_frozen_questions. Producer deterministic, fixture_mode=True, network_calls=0, no thresholds introduced. Frozen spec SHA256 verified before/after unchanged.
